Class FinalBuilderBoost

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.event.FinalBuilderBoost
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, IF_Event
public class FinalBuilderBoost extends Object implements IF_Event
Event "Final Builder Boost" from the Building Cards.
This Class Represents the Event "Final Builder Boost", which is a type of Building Card.
At the end of the Game, the Player gets extra Prestige Points based on the builders he has.

  • Method Details

    • handleEvent

      public void handleEvent(Player player)
      Handles the Building Event "Final Boost".
      This method handles the Building Event "Final Builder Boost" for the given Player, updating its parameters.
      Pre: player != null && board.players.contains(player)
      Post: (\forall CharacterCard c; player.tribe(BUILDER).contains(c); player.parameters(PRESTIGE_POINTS) = \old(player.parameters(PRESTIGE_POINTS) + (c.getPrestigePoints() * (multiplier - 1)))
      Specified by:
      handleEvent in interface IF_Event
      Parameters:
      player - Player to update due to the Event.
